question: Is dengue more dangerous the second time you get it?
X: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) occurs more often in people who have recovered from an infection with one dengue virus strain but are then re-infected with a different strain [1]. The exact reason for this phenomenon is not fully understood, but one theory suggests the immune system confuses the second strain and produces antibodies against the first [1].
Y: Dengue can be more dangerous the second time due to the immune system's confusion, but it is still generally manageable with proper care [1].
